title: Inefficient string concatenation
summary: Repeated std::string concatenation without capacity planning for large outputs.
rationale: Naive concatenation can repeatedly reallocate and copy data.

detection.notes: Find += or append patterns in loops where output size grows substantially.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Reserve capacity, use append with known sizes, fmt buffers, ostreams carefully, or streaming writers.
remediation.tradeoffs: Small strings may be optimized; avoid premature rewrites outside hot paths.
